purpose: GTA VI research, corroboration and article discovery. Not an automatic publishing allowlist.

policy.official_sources: primary evidence for Rockstar announcements and patch notes
policy.specialist_guides: secondary evidence for mechanics and cheat inputs; require direct in-game evidence for verified status
policy.journalists: attribute claims; never label leaks or reports official
policy.community: Collect source titles as leads with labels; never publish an unverified gameplay claim based only on metadata.
policy.media_reuse: Only with rights or official authorized media
policy.cheat_trophy_policy: No GTA VI code labeled trophy-safe without platform-specific evidence
policy.source_fetching: Public RSS/Atom feeds only; do not bypass login, robots restrictions or scrape protected community pages
policy.review_required: Community / data-miner claims cannot be auto-published; all scraped claims need corroboration before being turned into news.
policy.existing_official_monitor: The official Rockstar monitor remains sole owner of Rockstar's news and patches.

sources.name: Rockstar Newswire
sources.collection_note: Already monitored by official-only source pipeline; do not fetch or duplicate here.

sources.name: GTAForums
sources.collection_note: Forum homepage blocked to programmatic requests; follow source manually, no bypass

sources.name: GTA Wiki / Fandom
sources.collection_note: Wiki can include pre-release leaks and edit history: do not interpret as release facts

sources.name: GTABase
sources.collection_note: GTABase news public RSS endpoint reported by open source monitoring. Runtime probes source access each scan; failure stays explicitly unavailable and does not affect other feeds.

sources.name: GTANet
sources.collection_note: No validated public structured feed; consult manually for corroboration

sources.name: Tez2
sources.collection_note: No validated public structured feed; consult manually for corroboration

sources.name: Jason Schreier / Bloomberg
sources.collection_note: No validated public structured feed; consult manually for corroboration

verification.cheats: Compare exact buttons, unlocks, version, platform and independent sources; if conflicting mark disputed; no inferred sequences
verification.news: Prefer original reporting; distinguish first-party confirmation, attributed journalism, community discovery and speculation
verification.seo: Original Italian explanation, canonical source link, descriptive title and date; avoid duplicating original article
